faqs.question: What is Multi-Prep used for?
faqs.answer: Multi-Prep is an automated multi-sample homogenizer used for high-throughput parallel processing, homogenizing up to 6 samples at once for reproducible results.

faqs.question: How many samples can Multi-Prep process at once?
faqs.answer: Up to 6 samples process simultaneously, in mere seconds, reaching a maximum throughput of up to 300 samples per hour.

faqs.question: Does Multi-Prep require manual probe handling?
faqs.answer: No, the Multi-Prep Probes self-engage and self-disengage automatically, making it a genuinely walk-away system.

faqs.question: How does Multi-Prep prevent cross-contamination?
faqs.answer: A clean probe from the 12-pack is used for each sample, removing the need to stop and clean a single generator between samples.

faqs.question: What are the probes made from?
faqs.answer: Probes are made from 316 stainless steel and PTFE, a more durable, reusable alternative to disposable plastic generator probes, capable of handling tough tissue and frozen samples.

faqs.question: Can Multi-Prep probes be reused?
faqs.answer: Yes, probes are infinitely reusable and can be sterilized by flaming, autoclaving, or chemical cleaning.

faqs.question: What tube sizes does Multi-Prep support?
faqs.answer: Small or large Spider Tube Racks accommodate tubes from 5 mL to 50 mL, so existing tubes don't need to be changed.

faqs.question: How many programs can Multi-Prep store?
faqs.answer: Up to 10 different homogenizing programs store in memory, with a manual mode available for new trials or individual runs.

faqs.question: What is the price of Multi-Prep in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the probe pack and rack configuration selected. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your requirements are confirmed.

longForm.heroHook: Six samples at once, up to 300 an hour, walk-away automated.
longForm.heroLead: Homogenizing one sample at a time doesn't scale when your day has dozens of them lined up. Multi-Prep is built to process six simultaneously and let you walk away while it does. Fully automated multi-sample homogenizing runs up to 6 samples at once, in seconds, reaching a maximum throughput of 300 samples per hour, with self-engaging and self-disengaging Multi-Prep Probes making the whole process genuinely hands-off. An oscillating Spider Tube Rack mimics the up-down motion of hand-held homogenizing at 60 oscillations per minute, and up to 10 different homogenizing programs store directly in memory for consistent, repeatable protocols across your lab.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: Multi-Prep product information: parallel processing, probe design, and containment.
body: Up to 6 samples process simultaneously, in mere seconds, giving a maximum throughput of 300 samples per hour.
Automation runs through stress-free self-engagement and disengagement of the Multi-Prep Probes, making this a genuinely walk-away homogenizing system.
The oscillating Spider Tube Rack mimics the up-down motion of hand-held homogenizing at 60 oscillations per minute for enhanced homogenizing performance.
A 12-pack of 7mm or 10mm Multi-Prep Probes eliminates cross-contamination and removes the time-consuming need to stop and clean a generator between samples, since a clean probe is used each time.
Probes are made from 316 stainless steel and PTFE, a more durable alternative to disposable plastic generator probes, capable of processing tougher tissues and frozen samples.
Probes are infinitely reusable and can be sterilized by any cleaning method, including flaming, autoclaving, and chemical cleaning.

No need to change or alter the tubes already in use in your research, since small or large tube Spider Tube Racks accommodate 5 mL to 50 mL tubes, from 10 mL tubes up through 15/50 mL centrifuge tubes.
Up to 10 different homogenizing programs store in memory, and a manual mode is available for new homogenizing trials or quick, individual sample runs.
Processing takes place inside a sound-abating enclosure with a rounded, clear polycarbonate door for a full view of the process, alongside an ergonomically arranged LCD and control panel.
A 12-Pack of Multi-Prep Probes and a Spider Tube Rack are required to operate the unit and are sold separately.

sections.title: Automated, Cross-Contamination-Free Processing
sections.description: Stopping to clean a probe between every sample is one of the biggest hidden time costs in manual homogenizing, and it's exactly what Multi-Prep removes from the workflow. Self-engagement and disengagement of the Multi-Prep Probes happens automatically, meaning no manual probe handling interrupts a run once it starts. Because the system draws from a 12-pack of probes, a clean probe engages for every sample position, eliminating both cross-contamination risk and the time normally spent cleaning a single generator between runs. Built from 316 stainless steel and PTFE rather than disposable plastic, those probes hold up to tougher tissue types and frozen samples, and clean fully afterward by flaming, autoclaving, or chemical methods, ready for indefinite reuse.

sections.title: Programmability and Manual Mode
body: Different labs run different protocols, and Multi-Prep is built to hold onto those differences rather than forcing everyone through a single fixed setting.

Up to 10 different homogenizing programs store directly in the system's memory, so established protocols run consistently every time without needing to be re-entered or re-calibrated. For situations that fall outside a stored program, new homogenizing trials or a quick, single-sample run, manual mode handles individual sample processing directly, without needing to build a new program first. Both modes run through the same ergonomically arranged LCD and control panel, keeping programming parameters fully visible whichever mode is active.
